[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Soviet Union responded to the introduction of the Deutsche Mark by blockading all land and water access to West Berlin, leading to the Berlin Airlift.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The West provided support to opposition movements within the Soviet Union, such as the Solidarity movement in Poland, to undermine Soviet control.
